name: Maynooth University
description: Maynooth University is a public university in Maynooth, County Kildare, about 25 km west of Dublin. It became an independent university in 1997 and shares its campus with St Patrick's College, founded in 1795.
whyIncluded: Maynooth University is among the 10 universities in Ireland most chosen by international students (about 15% of its 12,263 full-time-equivalent students are international, THE World University Rankings 2026 data), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: Maynooth University's own estimate for a student renting off campus, for the 9-month academic year. Excludes tuition, flights, visas and insurance.
livingCosts.notes: Maynooth Student Budgeting Advice Service 'Living Expenses' planner, Off Campus table (monthly; yearly column = 9 months): housing = rent EUR 755 + utilities EUR 80; food EUR 400; transport = travel EUR 100; personal = books, materials & printing EUR 69 + clothes & medical EUR 75 + mobile phone EUR 30 + social life/misc EUR 150. Total EUR 1,604/month, EUR 14,435/year. On-campus alternative: rent EUR 720 + utilities EUR 77, total EUR 1,675/month. The page is undated; taken as the current (2026/27) guidance when read on 2026-10-07.

programmes.name: BSc Computer Science & Software Engineering (MH602)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international (non-EU) students for 2026/27. Maynooth has charged this same rate since 2024/25, but fees can be revised each year.
programmes.notes: Maynooth University 'International Undergraduate Courses Tuition Fee Schedule 2026/27' (dated 24.04.26): 'BSc - Computer Science & Software Eng (CSS)' EUR 18,000 per year ('All fees quoted above are for one academic year only'). The schedule lists no separate levy for non-EU undergraduates, so compulsory fees are 0. History: same course at EUR 18,000 in the 2025/26 schedule (dated 02.12.24) and the 2024/25 schedule (dated 14.12.23).
